name: a_megacap_premarket
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Mega-cap pre-market.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 4:00 PM ET (after the close) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, AVGO, AMD, MU, ORCL, NFLX: each one's pre-market % move on the brief date and any news since the session close (announcements, executive interviews and quotes, product events, analyst notes), and the reason reporters give for each move — including analyst warnings on the company or its sector (capex returns, valuation) and product controversies (privacy, safety, regulatory complaints).

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **NVDA** — AI Compute
- NVIDIA rose **0.5% in pre-market trading** on Monday, October 5, after reaching a record high on Friday; the report did not identify a new company-specific announcement as the cause. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 07:21 ET)
- NVIDIA closed Friday, October 2, at **$233.95**, up **1.34%**, after reaching an intraday record of **$237.55**. (LiveTradingNews, Oct. 5, 2026, 05:21 ET)
- Schwab strategist **Kevin Gordon** said a shortfall in a mega-cap company’s AI capital spending could disrupt the market, while noting that valuation and public pushback against AI were risks. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 01:33 ET)

## **MU** — Memory & Interconnect
- Micron fell **0.3% in pre-market trading** on Monday, October 5; Reuters grouped the move with weakness in semiconductor shares. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 07:21 ET)
- Schwab strategist **Kevin Gordon** said a reduction in AI capital-spending budgets could disrupt earnings across AI-related companies. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 01:33 ET)

## **TSLA** — Semiconductors / Automotive & Energy
- Tesla rose **4.65% on Friday, October 2**, making it one of the largest mega-cap contributors to the S&P 500’s gain; the available report attributed the broader market move to weaker-than-expected jobs data reducing near-term Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations. (Saxo Bank, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:20 ET)
- Tesla’s Friday gain was also reported as **4.7%** in Reuters coverage of the prior session. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 03:10 ET)

## **AVGO** — Communications & Networking
- Broadcom rose **3.35% on Friday, October 2**, according to a market recap; the recap attributed the broader technology-sector advance to weaker-than-expected payroll data and lower near-term rate-hike expectations. (Saxo Bank, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:20 ET)

## **AMD** — AI Compute
- AMD rose **2.95% on Friday, October 2**, as semiconductor stocks led the session’s advance; the available report did not identify a new AMD-specific announcement during the stated window. (Saxo Bank, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:20 ET)
- Schwab strategist **Kevin Gordon** warned that a single mega-cap AI-capex miss or reduced spending budget could disrupt earnings across the AI complex. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 01:33 ET)

## **GOOGL** — Internet & Platforms
- Alphabet rose **1.56% on Friday, October 2**; the available market recap linked the broader move to weaker-than-expected payroll data and reduced expectations for a near-term Fed rate hike. (Saxo Bank, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:20 ET)
- Alphabet was reported to own approximately **14% of Anthropic**, whose reported IPO roadshow targeted a possible October Nasdaq listing and a potential raise of up to **$100 billion** at a valuation near **$2 trillion**; the report marked the information as sourced reporting rather than a company announcement. [report] (Alpha Briefing, Oct. 4, 2026, 15:00 ET)

## **META** — Internet & Platforms
- Meta rose **0.30% on Friday, October 2**, according to a market recap; the available report did not identify a Meta-specific announcement during the window. (Saxo Bank, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:20 ET)
- Schwab strategist **Kevin Gordon** said a shortfall in a mega-cap company’s AI capital spending could disrupt the AI-driven market and cited valuation concerns and public pushback against AI. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 01:33 ET)

## Macro / AI Capital Spending
- Schwab strategist **Kevin Gordon** said the S&P 500 was **1% below its high**, while the average S&P 500 stock had experienced a **14% peak-to-trough drawdown** since early August. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 01:33 ET)
- Gordon said the market had become dependent on a small number of AI-related spending budgets and described the period as “CapEx season”; he warned that one spending miss accompanied by reduced budgets could disrupt earnings. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 01:33 ET)
- AllianceBernstein equities head **Nelson Yu** said the key issue for the upcoming earnings season was whether hyperscalers revised capital-expenditure plans. (Economic Times, Oct. 5, 2026, 03:19 ET)
- The Nasdaq 100 gained **1.00% on Friday, October 2**, reaching a record close, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose **2.4%** and the technology sector gained **1.01%**. (Saxo Bank, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:20 ET)
- The probability of at least a **25-basis-point** Federal Reserve rate increase at the end of October fell to **22.7%** from **24.4%** in the prior session and **64.2%** one week earlier, according to CME FedWatch data cited by Reuters. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 03:10 ET)
